title: A union with a float discriminant and a non-representable case value encodes bytes it cannot decode
severity_basis: Reachable only through a custom schema: the Stellar XDR definitions have no float-discriminated union. Fixed in js-xdr by a merged pull request that is not yet in a release the SDKs install.
caps_note: No CAP applies: an XDR encoding rule that holds in every protocol version (the corpus's xdr-strict group).

entries.expected: refuse a float union discriminant (RFC 4506 discriminants are int, unsigned int or enum)
entries.observed: Executed against the js-xdr each SDK version installs (4.0.0 for 16.x, 5.0.0 for 17.x): a union with switchOn float() and a case 0.1 is accepted, encodes the discriminant as 3dcccccd, and decoding those bytes fails ('no case for union discriminator 0.10000000149011612'). Fixed in js-xdr by pull request #171 (906a0aae), not released; no conformance driver offers this op yet, so the runner lists it

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L4, on every js column (16.3.0 - 17.4.0).
evidence.expected_basis: RFC 4506 section 4.15: a union discriminant is int, unsigned int or an enumerated type.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 7 of 7 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0021.json.

evidence_added.reason: The issue already holds the reproduction and the fix is merged upstream; what remains is a release, which is upstream's schedule.

history.note: Created from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/js-xdr/issues/162 and their failure rows.
The upstream item already records this defect.
